title: Undertow and Radiators
author: Astrid Eriksen
blurb: Petra Whitlock, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when the last speaker of a language asks for one final student, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
